PULSE-001.title: Overall Health Score
PULSE-001.what: Shows the overall health of the selected Business Moment as a single score (0–100) and status.
PULSE-001.why: Lets you instantly see whether this Moment is healthy, stable, or needs attention without scanning every widget.

how.default: A weighted 0–100 health score from activities, approvals, financial events, issues, risks, participation, and AI signals for this Moment. Recalculates when contributing drivers change.
how.TEAM_OPERATIONS: Team Health blends participation, approvals, open issues, and escalations for this Team Operations Moment.
how.BUSINESS_RUNWAY: Runway Health reflects cash position, burn, revenue, and collections for this Business Runway Moment.
how.BUSINESS_OPERATIONS: Operations Health blends budget control, open issues, pending approvals, and process improvements for this Business Operations Moment.

PULSE-002.title: Health Drivers
PULSE-002.what: Breaks the overall health score into its key contributing operational drivers.
PULSE-002.why: Shows which business areas are lifting or lowering overall health.

how.default: Shows 4–6 driver cards for the selected Business Moment Type. Each driver includes score, trend, and contribution to overall health.
how.TEAM_OPERATIONS: Drivers typically cover participation, approval progress, escalation closure, and workload balance.
how.BUSINESS_RUNWAY: Drivers typically cover budget control, issue resolution, approval flow, and improvement momentum.
how.BUSINESS_OPERATIONS: Drivers typically cover budget control, operational efficiency, approval progress, and process improvements.

PULSE-003.title: Attention Needed
PULSE-003.what: Lists the highest-priority operational items that need attention now.
PULSE-003.why: Keeps important approvals, issues, risks, and blockers from being overlooked.

how.default: Ranks pending items by urgency, business impact, and due dates. Highest-priority items appear first with severity indicators and quick navigation.

PULSE-004.title: Signals
PULSE-004.what: Shows intelligent business signals and emerging operational trends from Momentra AI.
PULSE-004.why: Helps you spot opportunities and risks before they become operational problems.

how.default: Analyses recent activity into positive, warning, or risk signals with trend indicators. Signals are workspace-aware and specific to this Moment.

PULSE-005.title: Recent Activity Feed
PULSE-005.what: Lists the latest operational activities for the selected Business Moment.
PULSE-005.why: Gives clear visibility into what changed recently in this Moment.

how.default: Newest-first feed with status, owner, timestamp, and activity type—filtered to the selected Business Workspace and Moment.

PULSE-006.title: Recommended Next Action
PULSE-006.what: Recommends the highest-value action that will most improve this Business Moment.
PULSE-006.why: Points you to the next step with the greatest operational impact.

how.default: Chosen from current health, attention items, activities, issues, approvals, and financial state. Selecting it opens the matching workflow or Quick Add screen.

MOMENT-001.title: Moment Summary
MOMENT-001.what: Shows key summary metrics for the selected Business Moment based on its type.
MOMENT-001.why: Gives an instant read on operational state without opening detailed reports.

how.default: Primary KPIs for the selected Business Moment Type, updated as operational data changes.
how.TEAM_OPERATIONS: Summary KPIs typically include Members, Approvers, and Teams.
how.BUSINESS_RUNWAY: Summary KPIs typically include Months Remaining, Cash Available, and Monthly Burn.
how.BUSINESS_OPERATIONS: Summary KPIs typically include Budget Used, Open Issues, and Pending Approvals.

MOMENT-002.title: Moment Timeline
MOMENT-002.what: Shows the chronological history of activities, approvals, updates, issues, milestones, and operational events.
MOMENT-002.why: Helps you see how this Business Moment has evolved over time.

how.default: Newest-first timeline with timestamps, status, owner, and activity type—filtered to this Workspace and Moment.

MOMENT-003.title: Progress Snapshot
MOMENT-003.what: Shows the most important execution metrics for current progress on this Business Moment.
MOMENT-003.why: Lets you judge execution performance without analysing multiple reports.

how.default: Shows 4–6 progress indicators for the selected Moment Type, each with current value and recent trend.
how.TEAM_OPERATIONS: Progress typically covers participation, approval progress, escalation closure, and workload balance.
how.BUSINESS_RUNWAY: Progress typically covers budget control, issue resolution, approval flow, and improvement momentum.
how.BUSINESS_OPERATIONS: Progress typically covers budget control, operational efficiency, approval progress, and process improvements.

MOMENT-004.title: Recent Highlights
MOMENT-004.what: Shows the most significant recent achievements, improvements, and milestones in this Business Moment.
MOMENT-004.why: Makes important progress easy to recognise without reading the full timeline.

how.default: High-impact operational events selected automatically and shown as concise highlight cards by significance and recency.

MOMENT-005.title: Continue Managing
MOMENT-005.what: Provides the primary action to continue work in the selected Business Moment.
MOMENT-005.why: Cuts navigation so you can resume operational work immediately.

how.default: Primary manage action for this Moment Type, with Quick Add when available.
how.TEAM_OPERATIONS: Opens Manage Team Operations (and Quick Add when available).
how.BUSINESS_RUNWAY: Opens Manage Runway (and Quick Add when available).
how.BUSINESS_OPERATIONS: Opens Manage Operations (and Quick Add when available).

LIFE-001.title: Business Life Health
LIFE-001.what: Shows overall health of the selected Business Workspace as a unified score (0–100).
LIFE-001.why: Lets owners instantly understand health across all active Business Moments in the workspace.

how.default: Aggregates health across active Business Moments in this workspace into an overall score, status, and short explanation.

LIFE-002.title: Connections & Influence
LIFE-002.what: Shows how different business functions contribute to overall workspace health.
LIFE-002.why: Highlights which areas have the greatest influence on overall success.

how.default: Contribution percentages across major business functions, recalculated as activity evolves.

LIFE-003.title: Business Drift Alert
LIFE-003.what: Detects gradual operational, financial, or strategic drift from expected performance.
LIFE-003.why: Supports early intervention before small deviations become larger problems.

how.default: Long-term behaviour analysis ranked into drift alerts with severity indicators.

LIFE-004.title: Highest Business Leverage
LIFE-004.what: Identifies the business area with the greatest opportunity to improve overall performance.
LIFE-004.why: Guides leadership to the highest-impact improvement opportunity.

how.default: Compares active Business Moments and recommends the area with the highest expected improvement potential.

LIFE-005.title: Trends
LIFE-005.what: Shows long-term performance trends across the Business Workspace.
LIFE-005.why: Helps you see whether the business is improving or declining over time.

how.default: Selected trend metrics over configurable periods with percentage movement and trend indicators.

LIFE-006.title: Drivers Growth
LIFE-006.what: Identifies drivers that are improving or reducing Business Life Health.
LIFE-006.why: Explains why overall performance is changing—not only the score.

how.default: Top improving and declining drivers ranked by overall impact, updated as performance changes.

LIFE-007.title: What Changed This Month?
LIFE-007.what: Summarises the most significant operational, financial, and organisational changes this month.
LIFE-007.why: Lets leaders review monthly progress without analysing multiple reports.

how.default: Monthly summary cards ranked by business significance from recent activity and milestones.

LIFE-008.title: Business Journey
LIFE-008.what: Shows major milestones across the evolution of the Business Workspace.
LIFE-008.why: Builds a lasting history of business growth and organisational progress.

how.default: Chronological milestone timeline with descriptions and achievement dates.

LIFE-009.title: Momentra Intelligence
LIFE-009.what: Generates AI-powered strategic insights across the entire Business Workspace.
LIFE-009.why: Turns operational history into actionable intelligence for decisions.

how.default: Workspace-wide analysis producing strategic recommendations, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.

LIFE-010.title: Quick Actions
LIFE-010.what: Provides one-tap access to the highest-priority business actions.
LIFE-010.why: Speeds execution by surfacing common actions without deep navigation.

how.default: Contextual actions such as Create Moment, Add Activity, Invite Team, or Open Workspace based on current state and permissions.

MEMORY-001.title: Business Memory Strength
MEMORY-001.what: Shows how mature the workspace’s organisational memory is as a unified score (0–100).
MEMORY-001.why: Helps owners see how much reliable organisational knowledge has been accumulated.

how.default: Aggregates learnings across active Business Moments into a Memory Score, maturity level, and short explanation. Score rises as validated learnings are captured.

MEMORY-002.title: Memory Network
MEMORY-002.what: Visualises how business knowledge connects across operations, finance, vendors, events, and teams.
MEMORY-002.why: Shows how functions influence each other and contribute to organisational memory.

how.default: Network of connections between major business domains. Relationships strengthen as more historical data is available.

MEMORY-003.title: Recent Learnings
MEMORY-003.what: Shows the latest organisational learnings discovered from business activities and decisions.
MEMORY-003.why: Preserves valuable lessons instead of losing them after execution.

how.default: Concise learning cards ordered by recency and confidence from recent organisational insights.

MEMORY-004.title: Pattern Distribution
MEMORY-004.what: Groups organisational learnings into major business knowledge categories.
MEMORY-004.why: Shows where the organisation is learning most—and where knowledge is thin.

how.default: Categorised distribution across areas such as Operations, Finance, Delivery, Approvals, Vendors, and Execution.

MEMORY-005.title: Success Memory
MEMORY-005.what: Highlights behaviours, processes, and decisions that consistently produced positive outcomes.
MEMORY-005.why: Helps teams repeat proven practices instead of rediscovering them.

how.default: Recurring successful patterns shown as high-value organisational successes with confidence levels.

MEMORY-006.title: Memory Gaps
MEMORY-006.what: Identifies areas where historical data is too thin for reliable intelligence.
MEMORY-006.why: Encourages better documentation so future recommendations improve.

how.default: Knowledge-coverage analysis that surfaces prioritised gaps where history is weak.

MEMORY-007.title: Business Wisdom
MEMORY-007.what: Shows the highest-value strategic lesson learned across the Business Workspace.
MEMORY-007.why: Turns historical experience into reusable guidance for future decisions.

how.default: Synthesises multiple learnings into one high-confidence organisational insight that updates as new patterns emerge.

MEMORY-008.title: Momentra Intelligence
MEMORY-008.what: Generates AI-powered predictive insights from accumulated organisational memory.
MEMORY-008.why: Helps the business move from recording history to better future decisions.

how.default: Analyses organisational memory for predictive insights, emerging opportunities, and forward-looking recommendations.

MEMORY-009.title: Quick Actions
MEMORY-009.what: Provides one-tap access to common memory and learning actions.
MEMORY-009.why: Makes it easy to keep strengthening organisational memory.

how.default: Contextual actions such as Review Learnings, Add Activity, Explore Memory, or Record Business Insight based on memory maturity.
